NOTE-1. The retained transcripts in docs/sessions/evidence/task775/checks-20260831/*.log record the command and EXIT_CODE but carry no environment header: no node.exe -p process.platform, no Node version, no cwd, which the review skill requires of retained transcripts. Independently confirmed - grep for 'process.platform' or 'win32' across those logs returns no file. Correctly recorded as a limitation rather than back-filled with metadata that was never captured. Correction belongs to the next evidence run: emit the header to its own file before the first gate.

NOTE-2. Three runs all carry label 'current'. -01 failed 28/28 cells on 'nextjs-portal present - next dev server detected, refusing to capture'. -02 shows ZERO failing cells yet is still superseded: it carries probeHash f809ff2f... and gitCommit 4b96655e5..., i.e. it ran an older probe. ROOT CAUSE, owner-supplied and confirmed against the artifacts: the production data set has only two listings, so /listings renders no pagination control at all and the probe's '.listings-pagination -> button 2' locator could never resolve. Commit 95c3ba570 therefore removed the pagination interaction outright (21 lines deleted from the probe) and amended the kickoff's AC7 to read verbatim: 'Pagination is not assessed by Task 775: the current route has two listings and renders no pagination control. This is neither a pass nor a defect finding.' The route probe consequently carries three interactions, not four, which is exactly what run -03 records. DURABLE CONSEQUENCE for the rest of Sprint 68: pagination is not provable at route level with the current data set; its only proof surface is Storybook. Both failed runs retained on purpose (4c4be8ee3). Residual risk: a run label that cannot distinguish superseded from accepted leaves the manifest as the only guard.
